omar.sec: Policy update: starting 2026-07-01 we will enforce strict redirect_uri validation for all internal OAuth clients and rotate any client secrets that do not have an owner or have not been rotated in 90 days. This reduces open redirect/risk from leaked client secrets. Docs: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oauth-hardening :warning:

deploy-bot: oauth-scan results: 84 clients with wildcard/loose redirect URIs, 46 clients with no owner metadata, 28 clients with secrets >180 days. Report: https://redwood.internal/reports/oauth-scan-2093001234

maya.platform: will this impact CI/deploy keys that use oauth for token exchange?

omar.sec: yes potentially. Action plan: owners must (1) narrow redirect_uris to exact hosts/paths, (2) add owner metadata (team + email) via the admin console, (3) rotate secrets or switch to signed-jwt client auth (recommended). Deadline to fix: 2026-06-20.

todd.sre: any helper for bulk updates? we have ~15 internal clients for infra tooling.

ops-bot: bulk update API: `POST https://api.redwood.internal/oauth/clients/bulk-update -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"client_ids":["c1","c2"],"owner_email":"infra@redwood.com"}'` Returns job id. CSV export: `https://api.redwood.internal/oauth/clients?filter=loose_redirect&format=csv`

omar.sec: Example strict redirect: replace `https://*.example.com/callback` with `https://deploy.example.com/oauth/callback` or `https://deploy.example.com/services/service-a/callback`. For switching to JWT auth, see sample: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oauth-hardening#jwt-client-auth

maya.platform: please DM the infra client list and we'll schedule a rotation window.

deploy-bot: infra client list queued; will DM infra leads in 10m.

omar.sec: Exceptions allowed only for legacy third-party integrations with documented compensating controls. File `sec-exception:oauth` ticket with justification and expiry. Exceptions require review by ID and infra sec.

todd.sre: noted, making a ticket for the router-service clients.

omar.sec: Short checklist:
- Owners: fix redirect_uris, add owner metadata, rotate or migrate to JWT by 2026-06-20.
- Security: will run final enforcement scan 2026-06-25 and disable non-compliant clients 2026-07-01.
- Questions: sec-automations@redwood.com or ping me (omar.sec).

maya.platform: ack, will coordinate. :thumbsup:
